body:
A well-made catalog does more than list products — it carries your brand story from the shelf to the client handshake. ZprintPro prints catalogs, photo books and exhibition lookbooks for retailers, e-commerce brands, agencies and small businesses across the US and global markets, with 95%+ color accuracy on every sheet. Whether you need an art exhibition lookbook, a brand portfolio, a photography book, an annual report or a keepsake album, a 30-second AI quote and a free design mockup get you started before you commit a single dollar.

For retail and wholesale buyers, china catalog printing at a reliable Asia factory keeps unit costs low while color stays consistent from one reorder to the next. E-commerce brands refresh seasonal lookbooks through the same workflow, and agencies keep a saddle stitch booklet format handy for quick client proofs at trade shows. Because Q4 is our peak season, customers who confirm artwork early avoid the holiday rush.

Event teams and corporate gifting programs rely on catalogs that feel substantial — a laminated cover, a clean table of contents, and chapter markers that let buyers jump straight to the right category. Our free layout support adds page numbers, tables of contents and chapter labels to your PDF or AI files, so even a rough draft can become press-ready.

Inside pages print on 157–200g coated art paper for stiffness and crisp reproduction, with a 200–250g coated cover; standard sizes are A4 (210×297mm) or A5 (148×210mm). Four-color offset delivers saturated color suited to photos and illustrations, finished with matte or glossy lamination, optional foil stamping, and saddle stitch or perfect binding depending on your page count.

A 100-copy minimum keeps your first order manageable, and pricing starts at HK$2.8 per book — digital for small batches, offset for volume. After you approve a free digital proof within 4 hours, DHL Express delivers in 2-4 days to the US and worldwide, with free shipping on US orders over $99.

**FAQ**

**Q1: Do you offer free layout help?**

Yes — free layout support covers tables of contents, page numbers and chapter markers on your PDF or AI artwork.

**Q2: What if I need to see a proof before the run?**

You receive a free digital proof within 4 hours, and nothing goes to press until you approve it.

**Q3: Can small orders really be printed?**

Small batches print digitally with the same color quality, then scale to offset as your volume grows.

Ready to turn your artwork into a catalog customers keep? Get a free digital proof within 1 hour — message +86 198 8085 1334 on WhatsApp or click the "30-second AI quote" button on this page.
